allowedSourceMaterial.overview: The story of the Cuban Missile Crisis in 1962—the nuclear standoff with the USSR sparked by the discovery by the Americans of missile bases established on the Soviet-allied island of Cuba.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When surveillance reveals Soviet missile installations just off American shores, how do leaders navigate the razor-thin margin between diplomacy and global conflict?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In October 1962, American discovery of Soviet missile bases established in Cuba triggers a high-stakes Cold War standoff, plunging leadership into a fraught nuclear showdown directed by Roger Donaldson.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A tense, deliberate historical thriller with heavy emotional weight, demanding engaged focus across its 145-minute runtime.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Roger Donaldson directs a gripping, history-rooted thriller where every calculated political move and diplomatic calculation carries the threat of catastrophic escalation.
